# equinix_fabric_internet_access_services (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to search for Equinix Internet Access (EIA) services with pagination details.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/Internet-Access



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (Attributes) Filters for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Optional

- `pagination` (Attributes) Pagination details for the returned Internet Access services list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))
- `sort` (Attributes) Sort criteria for the Data Source Search Request (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sort))

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returned list of Internet Access service objects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Operator to use on your filtered field with the values given. One of: [=, !=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE, ILIKE, BETWEEN, >, >=, <, <=, ~*]
- `property` (String) Field name to use on filters, e.g. "/project/projectId", "/name", "/state", "/type"
- `values` (List of String) The values that you want to apply the property+operator combination to in order to filter your data search


<a id="nestedatt--pagination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pagination`

Optional:

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of search results returned per page. Number must be between 1 and 100, and the default is 20
- `offset` (Number) Index of the first item returned in the response. The default is 0

Read-Only:

- `next` (String) The URL relative to the next item in the response
- `previous` (String) The URL relative to the previous item in the response
- `total` (Number) The total number of Internet Access services available to the user making the request


<a id="nestedatt--sort"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sort`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) The sorting direction. Can be one of: [DESC, ASC], Defaults to ASC
- `property` (String) The property name to use in sorting, e.g. "/name". Defaults to "/name". Note: sorting by "/changeLog/createdDateTime" currently makes the API return a server error


<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `account` (Attributes) Account associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--account))
- `bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth of the service
- `bandwidth_commit` (Number) Minimum bandwidth commit for the burst billing variant of the service
- `billing` (Attributes) Billing details of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--billing))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Audit log of changes to the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the Internet Access service
- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--locations))
- `name` (String) Name of the Internet Access service
- `order` (Attributes) Order details of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--order))
- `project` (Attributes) Project associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--project))
- `routing_protocol` (Attributes) Routing protocol configuration of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--routing_protocol))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the service. One of: PROVISIONING, PROVISIONED, FAILED, DEPROVISIONING, DEPROVISIONED
- `type` (String) Type of the Internet Access service. One of: SINGLE_IA, DUAL_IA
- `use_case` (String) Use case of the service. One of: MAIN, MANAGEMENT_ACCESS
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the Internet Access service

<a id="nestedatt--data--account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.account`

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String) Account number
- `href` (String) URI to the account


<a id="nestedatt--data--billing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.billing`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether billing is enabled
- `start_date` (String) Start date of the billing period
- `type` (String) Billing type. One of: FIXED, USAGE_BASED, BURST_BASED


<a id="nestedatt--data--change"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.change`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the change resource

Read-Only:

- `created_date_time` (String) Creation time of the service
- `deleted_date_time` (String) Deletion time of the service

<a id="nestedatt--data--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.locations`

Read-Only:

- `metro_href` (String) URI to the metro resource

<a id="nestedatt--data--order"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.order`

Read-Only:

- `order_id` (String) Order identification

<a id="nestedatt--data--project"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.project`

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--data--routing_protocol"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.routing_protocol`

Read-Only:

- `connections` (Attributes List) Fabric connections attached to the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--routing_protocol--connections))

- `type` (String) Routing protocol type. One of: BGP, DIRECT, STATIC

<a id="nestedatt--data--routing_protocol--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.routing_protocol.connections`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the connection

- `peering_ipv6` (Attributes) IPv6 peering details of the connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--routing_protocol--connections--peering_ipv6))

<a id="nestedatt--data--routing_protocol--connections--peering_ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.routing_protocol.connections.peering_ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `customer_peer_ip` (String) Peering IP address on the customer side

- `equinix_vrrp_ip` (String) VRRP IP address on the Equinix side
- `prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix for the peering connection
- `prefix_length` (Number) Determines the size of the subnet


<a id="nestedatt--data--routing_protocol--connections--peering_ipv6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.routing_protocol.connections.peering_ipv6`

- `prefix` (String) IPv6 prefix for the peering connection
- `prefix_length` (Number) Determines the size of the subnet
